**Premise correction:** There is no GraphQL schema in this repository. Memos does not use GraphQL at all.

**Actual API surface:** The public API is a **gRPC API defined in Protocol Buffer (`.proto`) files**, with an auto-generated **gRPC-Gateway REST/HTTP layer** on top. The source-of-truth definitions live in:

- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/user_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto`
- `proto/api/v1/common.proto` (shared types)

These `.proto` files are compiled to produce Go gRPC stubs and gRPC-Gateway reverse-proxy code under `proto/gen/api/v1/` (e.g., `memo_service.pb.gw.go`, `user_service.pb.gw.go`, etc.), which expose 81 REST endpoints under `/api/v1/...`. Additional non-gRPC routes exist for file serving (`/attachments/`, `/users/:identifier/avatar`), RSS (`/explore/rss.xml`, `/u/:username/rss.xml`), SSE (`/api/v1/sse`), frontend assets (`/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`), and a health check (`/healthz`).

No `.graphql` files exist anywhere in the repository.
